mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SMS_AUTH ( USER_PHONE, AUTH_CODE, AUTH_PURPOSE, AUTH_YN, EXPIRE_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userPhone}, #{authCode}, #{authPurpose}, 'N', #{expireAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT AUTH_CODE, AUTH_YN, EXPIRE_AT FROM SMS_AUTH WHERE USER_PHONE = #{userPhone} AND AUTH_PURPOSE = #{authPurpose} AND AUTH_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRE_AT > NOW()
ORDER BY AUTH_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AUTH_ID FROM SMS_AUTH WHERE USER_PHONE = #{userPhone} AND AUTH_PURPOSE = #{authPurpose} AND AUTH_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY AUTH_ID DESC LIMIT 1
